title: Crossfire
gameText: Deploy on table. When you fire two weapons (except lightsabers) in a battle, your total power is +5. Also, S-foils and Maneuvering Flaps are suspended where you have a weapon present or a starship with maneuver > 3 present. (Immune to Alter.)
evidence: Full printed image inspected; Crossfire destiny4 overlays approved RG-PROOF-17. Credits2/1/1. Crossfire and Flagship differ from older rules; We Have A Prisoner capture instead is a replacement event, using standard engine timing.

title: Flagship Operations
gameText: Deploy on your Star Destroyer if at least 4 Executor sites on table. Your TIEs are deploy -1, forfeit +2 and destiny +1. At systems where you have a TIE, your Imperial capital starships are deploy -3 and your battle destiny draws are +1 each.
evidence: Full printed image inspected; Crossfire destiny4 overlays approved RG-PROOF-17. Credits2/1/1. Crossfire and Flagship differ from older rules; We Have A Prisoner capture instead is a replacement event, using standard engine timing.

title: We Have A Prisoner
gameText: Use 1 Force if opponent just lost or forfeited a character from battle. Character is captured instead. OR Use X Force to capture all characters aboard a captured starship, where X = twice the number of characters.
